subject: Document workflow idea for Birlasoft
email:
Hi Birlasoft team,

I was looking through Birlasoft's public site and noticed public material on "IntelliBridge Integration Platform and Solutions" and "NextGen Cloud Infrastructure Services: Scalable IT Solutions".

That made me curious about the document work behind those opportunities. For cloud, data, and modernization engagements, proposal teams may need to adapt technical scope, proof points, delivery language, and reusable case-study material for each opportunity.

I would want to validate whether that is actually a painful part of your workflow before assuming the fit.
